decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-184 MODIFY for one-time-email-code access. Adding SIWE for Transak-created wallets belongs to Wallet Authentication and does not alter the email-authentication requirement.
The existing message-184 FAQ MODIFY already includes the fiat-buyer section and its one-time-email-code or SIWE access explanation; no additional FAQ state change is required.

The candidate already captures the message-184 wallet provisioning and mint-destination changes. SIWE access after minting is an authentication behavior and does not further change the fiat-mint requirement.
The Wallet Authentication change does not alter email delivery behavior, and the separate message-184 email-content requirements are already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
Extending SIWE authentication to Transak-created wallets does not require any change to the About-page content state.
Wallet-based dashboard access for fiat buyers does not change the automatic prize-payout mechanism, which is already separately updated by message 184.
The authentication-path extension does not change the NFT token serial's role or display locations. The separate confirmation-email change from message 184 is already represented.
The reader engine and reader entry points are independently established by message 184 and are not changed by the Wallet Authentication modification.
Adding authenticated dashboard access for fiat buyers does not change the unauthenticated status of public leaderboard and pool-value APIs.

Message 184 restates that commissions reach the referrer's wallet automatically, but the candidate already requires automatic immediate wallet payout; the authentication change introduces no new commission state.
Access through a Transak-created wallet does not change which NFT-associated rights, badges, referral identity, or tickets follow a secondary transfer.
The Wallet Authentication modification does not change the $30 mint price, commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
